description: Given one creator address, return every wallet that was early in that creator's launches: the role each played (creator, repeat_buyer, one_off), how many of this creator's launches it was early in versus how many it was early in anywhere, and the creator's own rug rate against the chain baseline, because a rate without its baseline is not a finding. It does not say who owns the wallets.

chain.description: Which chain the creator launched on.

creator.description: Creator address. base58 for Solana, 0x... for Robinhood Chain.

limit.description: Maximum wallet rows to return. The response reports wallets_truncated when it caps.

role.description: Optional filter. Omit for all roles.

name: groundtruth_screen_creator
